name: Asukaze Rin
source:
"Huh? Me? I'm Rin Asukaze! I'm an agent too, okay? I'm like, SUPER busy! Anyone who gets in the way of my honeymoon with ARATA... will regret it!"

A different person from the real Rin Asukaze, though they look alike.

It's strange how similar they are... But don't let her sweet appearance fool you—her personality is the complete opposite. She's a dangerously volatile woman.

[From [url=https://ifi.games/deathendz/chara/?page=category9&ch=asukaze]official website[/url]]
